description: Choose this when an agent needs the readable content of a public webpage as deterministic clean Markdown, without screenshots or browser execution. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402. Successful paid calls settle the authorized USDC payment and create a stored report; settlement reduces the payer's balance and cannot be undone by this tool. The target website is not modified. Requires an x402-aware client to authorize payment.

maxOutputTokens.description: Optional approximate output budget from 500 to 12000 tokens.

url.description: Public HTTPS page URL. Private, loopback, credentialed, and non-HTTPS URLs are rejected.

name: extract_page
